<title level="1" right="Class Feature 9">[Ranger Expertise](/Classes.aspx?ID=9)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 166

**Class** Ranger
</column>

---

You’ve practiced your techniques to make them harder to resist. Your proficiency rank for your ranger class DC increases to expert.

<title level="1" right="Class Feature 9">[Ranger Expertise](/Classes.aspx?ID=36)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 152

**Class** Ranger
</column>

---

You've gained techniques that improve your cunning and skill. Your proficiency rank for your ranger DC increases to expert. If you have warden spells, your proficiency rank for spell attacks and spell DCs increases to expert.
